items.comments:
Phuc's place is great! It very spacious, well maintained, clean, and he has nice furniture and amenities. The beds are super comfortable, the apartment gets lots of light and is a quick ride from lots of attractions. 

We had an awesome time here! Phuc was easy to work with, responsive, and friendly. 

10/10, I would def come back here next time I'm in Seattle.

Very nice condo in a great neighborhood. Close to everything! The neighbors were very friendly, both in the building & adjacent buildings. We really enjoyed our time here & would highly recommend this rental to others.
I was looking for a place to crash not too far outside of downtown Seattle and Phuc's place was perfect.  We had a great stay with no problems.

Phuc was a great host for our weekend retreat to Seattle. He was very accommodating when it came time for check in. My pals and I came in on late flights (10PM), so Phuc dropped off the keys to his place at a nearby Hotel so we could pick them up. His place was extremely fitting for our party of 5.
